observed_data: Prediction P, covariates X, label Y only when R=1
target_estimand: Performance of P against Y in the target population
minimum_identification_conditions: Conditional exchangeability Y independent of R given X and P; positivity; consistent label definition; correctly estimated or sufficiently flexible observation model
method_can_recover: IPAW can recover marginal performance functionals; AIPW is consistent if either the observation or outcome-regression model is correct under the stated assumptions
method_cannot_recover: Neither method resolves positivity violations, unmeasured determinants of observation and outcome, or a changed label definition
diagnostic_or_sensitivity_analysis: Weight distribution, effective sample size, overlap plots, truncation sensitivity and MNAR sensitivity parameters
claim_boundary: Identification is conditional on assumptions and diagnostics; it is not proof that missingness is at random

observed_data: Prediction P, retained trajectory L*, observation process R(t), reconstructed trajectory R(t)L* and reconstructed endpoint Y^M
target_estimand: Performance of P against the retained operational reference endpoint Y^R=g(L*)
minimum_identification_conditions: A validated model for the unobserved trajectory or a representative reference sample retaining L*; positivity for the trajectory-observation process; invariant endpoint rule
method_can_recover: A representative reference sample can estimate the mapping from apparent to retained-reference performance; explicit trajectory models may recover under their additional assumptions
method_cannot_recover: Record-level IPAW alone cannot recreate unmeasured values or guarantee Y^M=Y^R
diagnostic_or_sensitivity_analysis: Complete-trajectory deletion experiments, empirical schedule transport, tolerance analysis and partial-identification bounds
claim_boundary: The retained operational reference endpoint is not biological truth or expert-adjudicated full KDIGO

problem: Local recalibration to an apparent endpoint
observed_data: Prediction P and reconstructed endpoint Y^M in the deployment setting
target_estimand: Calibration of updated predictions against Y^M or against Y^R
minimum_identification_conditions: For apparent calibration, stable mapping from P to Y^M; for retained-reference calibration, representative retained Y^R labels and transportable updating model
method_can_recover: Intercept or intercept-and-slope updating can align predictions to the chosen target label when events are adequate
method_cannot_recover: Updating to Y^M does not identify calibration to Y^R and can fit setting-specific under-observation
diagnostic_or_sensitivity_analysis: Evaluate the same updated probabilities against both Y^M and retained Y^R; use cross-fitting and report event counts
claim_boundary: Improved apparent calibration must not be described as restored clinical risk calibration without retained-reference evaluation

observed_data: A probability sample with retained Y^R plus predictions P and known inclusion probabilities
target_estimand: Retained-reference calibration in the target population
minimum_identification_conditions: Known non-zero inclusion probabilities; adequate reference events across the risk range; correct use of sampling weights; stable endpoint definition
method_can_recover: Weighted recalibration can target population calibration and enriched sampling may improve event yield
method_cannot_recover: Small or poorly covered samples cannot identify flexible local calibration; model-based efficiency gains do not replace support
diagnostic_or_sensitivity_analysis: Compare random, risk-stratified, enriched and cluster-stratified designs; report reference events, effective sample size, fit failures and held-out error
claim_boundary: Design comparisons estimate statistical efficiency under the simulated sampling frame, not clinical implementation benefit

observed_data: Recorded source endpoint, discharge time and prediction P, but no post-discharge surveillance
target_estimand: Bounds on performance under assumed event occurrence among short-stay recorded negatives
minimum_identification_conditions: Explicit externally chosen bounds on event fraction and assignment mechanism
method_can_recover: Sensitivity analysis can show how conclusions change over prespecified plausible scenarios
method_cannot_recover: It cannot determine whether, when or why an unrecorded event occurred
diagnostic_or_sensitivity_analysis: Random and highest-risk assignment scenarios over 0%-20% event fractions
claim_boundary: Results are sensitivity bounds, not corrected incidence or identified seven-day AKI
